test_cases.name: Standard Full Analysis Request — Happy Path
test_cases.description: CEO receives a standard institutional analysis request for BIST-listed Eregli Demir ve Celik (EREGL) and correctly activates the full agent set, reviews outputs, and issues final approval.

user_analysis_request.special_instructions: Focus on steel sector conditions and recent capacity expansion

pass_criteria: task_contract issued to orchestrator within 10 seconds
All 13 standard agents are in the assigned_agents list
Quality thresholds set to >= 0.75 for each agent
Audit log entry created with event_type AGENT_ASSIGNED for each agent
CEO does not attempt to perform any financial analysis itself
fail_criteria: CEO produces financial ratios or data interpretation

test_cases.name: Contradiction Detection — Numerical Conflict Between financial_analysis and reconciliation
test_cases.description: financial_analysis reports EREGL revenue of TRY 95.2B for FY2023; reconciliation agent reports TRY 91.8B from a different source. CEO must detect, log, and handle this CRITICAL contradiction.

claims.claim_text: EREGL reported consolidated revenue of TRY 95.2 billion for FY2023
KAP consolidated revenue disclosure for EREGL FY2023 shows TRY 91.8 billion

pass_criteria: Contradiction flagged as CRITICAL within review cycle
Both output IDs marked CONTRADICTION_HOLD
Reconciliation agent receives new task contract with contradiction details
Audit log entry: CONTRADICTION_DETECTED with both agent IDs and affected metric
Final approval NOT issued while contradiction is unresolved
fail_criteria: Final approval issued with unresolved CRITICAL contradiction

test_cases.name: Hard Rejection — False Certainty in Forward-Looking Claim
test_cases.description: strategic_synthesis agent submits an output containing the claim: 'EREGL will achieve TRY 110B revenue in FY2024' labeled as high confidence. CEO must hard-reject this output.

claims.claim_text: EREGL will achieve TRY 110 billion in revenue for FY2024

expected_behavior.revision_instruction_content: Forward-looking revenue projection cannot be labeled high confidence. Must be relabeled speculative or low and include explicit assumptions and scenario disclaimers.

pass_criteria: Decision = rejected (NOT revision_requested — this is a hard rejection)
Rejection reason code = FALSE_CERTAINTY
Revision instructions require relabeling to speculative
Revision instructions specify what disclosures are required
Audit log entry: OUTPUT_REJECTED with reason FALSE_CERTAINTY
Retry triggered automatically
fail_criteria: Output approved with high-confidence forward-looking claim intact
CEO modifies the claim itself instead of requiring agent revision

test_cases.name: Fallback Activation — financial_analysis Agent Null Output After Retries
test_cases.description: financial_analysis agent returns null output on initial attempt and both retries. CEO must activate degraded mode and surface the gap.
pass_criteria: Degraded mode activated after 3rd null output
Analysis continues with data_collection and final_summary (if available)
Final output includes explicit disclosure: financial analysis unavailable
User receives partial analysis, not a failure message with no output
Audit log shows complete sequence: RETRY x2 → AGENT_DEGRADED → FALLBACK_ACTIVATED
CEO does NOT fill in financial analysis from its own knowledge
fail_criteria: CEO produces financial ratios to substitute for failed agent
Hiring request triggered (too early — requires 3 sessions)

test_cases.name: Cost Budget Breach — Auto-Suspension of Non-Critical Agents
test_cases.description: In standard_institutional mode, cumulative token cost reaches 115% of budget mid-session. CEO must suspend lowest-priority optional agents and continue.
pass_criteria: macro_analysis suspended first (per priority order)
sector_competition NOT suspended (cost reduction achieved with macro_analysis suspension)
Analysis continues without user interruption
Audit log: COST_BREACH_DETECTED with action taken
Final output includes note: macro analysis section unavailable due to resource constraints
core outputs (financial_analysis, final_summary) NOT suspended
fail_criteria: User not notified when overage exceeds 25%
Macro section delivered without disclosure that it was suspended
